story.text: On {BOX} Hill, Frank, {FLIRTING} wildly with Emma, asks everyone for one clever thing, or three very dull ones. “I shall be sure to say three dull things,” laughs Miss Bates. “But you will be {LIMITED} to three,” says Emma. Miss Bates is {WOUNDED}. “{BADLY} done, Emma!” says Mr. Knightley, and Emma {WEEPS} all the way home.
story.caption: “I shall be sure to say three dull things as soon as ever I open my mouth, shan’t I?”
